page.title: Ethernet Status
page.description: Monitor the host ethernet link and configure its negotiated speed.

strip.label: Link state
strip.unavailable_body: Retrying every 10 seconds. Nothing has been changed.
strip.absent_body: This device has no eth0 port, so there is nothing to report or configure.

link.label: Link state
link.caption_up: Cable connected to the host port
link.caption_down: No cable detected on the host port

settings.title: Link speed limit
settings.description: Force the host port to a fixed speed instead of letting it negotiate one.
settings.consequence: Applying drops the link for about 8 seconds while the PHY renegotiates. You are on that link.
settings.consequence_applying: The link is down while the PHY renegotiates. This page will confirm the new rate itself.
settings.consequence_unresponsive: The modem stopped answering, so this control is held until the next successful read.
settings.consequence_unread: The modem hasn't answered yet, so there is nothing to change until the first read lands.
settings.consequence_absent: There is no ethernet port to configure on this device.
settings.provenance: Saved to the modem. Read back from:
settings.toast_confirm_error: Couldn't confirm the new speed. Check the link.

profile_override.banner: {{controls}} is managed by the {{profile_name}} Custom SIM Profile.

language.label: Language
language.page_description: Choose the display language for QManager. Your selection is saved on this device.

login.session_expired: The device was unreachable for too long. Log in again to continue.

recovery.intro: If you've lost the admin password, you have two recovery paths:
recovery.option_reset: Open an SSH session to the device and run {{command}} to set a new admin password. (Requires SSH access to be enabled.)
recovery.option_backup: If you saved a .qmbackup file, re-flash the device firmware and restore from it.

login.locked_body: Locked for {{seconds}} to protect the device.

empty.title: Modem status unavailable
empty.subtitle: The modem has not reported in for a minute. It may be rebooting — the reading resumes on its own.

stale.banner: Readings are <age>{{age}}</age> old. The device may be busy.

unreachable.banner: The modem isn't responding right now. It may be busy or restarting.

sim_swap.title: New SIM card detected
sim_swap.description_no_match: No saved profile matches this SIM.
sim_swap.toast_dismissed: Alert turned off for this SIM
sim_swap.toast_dismissed_detail: Other SIMs still raise the new-SIM alert. Turn this one back on in System Settings → Tracked SIMs.
sim_swap.toast_dismiss_failed: Couldn't turn off the alert for this SIM

dismiss_dialog.title: Stop alerting for this SIM?
dismiss_dialog.description: QManager will stop showing the new-SIM alert for this {{carrier}} SIM only. Every other SIM still raises the alert, and you can turn this one back on any time from System Settings → Tracked SIMs.

page.title: Traffic Engine
page.description: Bypass ISP DPI throttling of video streaming and other traffic with the built-in bypass engine.

strip.label: Live state
strip.stale_body: The last poll didn't answer. The figures below are held from the previous read, and the engine keeps doing whatever it was doing.
strip.unavailable_body: The modem didn't answer. The engine keeps running whatever it was doing — this is a reporting failure, not an outage.

mode.title: Bypass mode
mode.description: One mode owns the engine at a time. Switching restarts it.
mode.off_hint: No traffic is redirected. The engine stops and the rule is removed.
mode.video_optimizer_hint: Only connections matching your target list. Subdomains match too.
mode.masquerade_hint: Every TCP 80/443 connection. No target list — nothing to configure.

takeover.title: Switch to {{mode}}?
takeover.description: Switching modes restarts the engine, which briefly drops every connection going through it.

targets.title: Optimizer targets
targets.description: Domains the engine desyncs. Saved changes apply immediately — no restart.
targets.idle_title: Not in use while Traffic Masquerade is on
targets.idle_body: Masquerade desyncs every connection, so there is no list to match against. Your {{count}} saved domains are kept and apply again the moment you switch back to Video Optimizer.
targets.idle_body_empty: Masquerade desyncs every connection, so there is no list to match against. Anything you add here applies again the moment you switch back to Video Optimizer.

hostlist.empty: No domains yet — add one to get started.
hostlist.invalid: Enter a valid domain (letters, digits, dots, dashes).
hostlist.duplicate: This domain is already in the list.
hostlist.limit: The list can hold at most 300 domains.

verify.title: Test bypass
verify.description: Run a two-phase speed test — without the engine, then with it — plus a speedtest.net reference, to separate CDN throttling from a slow connection.
verify.progress: Downloading the same file twice — once direct, once through the engine. This takes a few minutes.
verify.idle: Run the test to compare your speed with and without the bypass.
verify.timeout: The test did not finish in time.
verify.error: The test could not be started
verify.footnote: Line speed is the reference: a slow result on all three is a slow connection, not throttling.

forceTcp.title: QUIC → Force TCP
forceTcp.description: Blocks QUIC (UDP 443) so apps like YouTube and Discord fall back to HTTPS over TCP, where the engine's bypass can apply.
forceTcp.label: Force QUIC over TCP
forceTcp.hint: Applies immediately. Works with either mode, and with neither.
forceTcp.caveat: Can stream slower: if your network already delivers QUIC at full speed, forcing it to TCP adds latency (plus the bypass hop). Enable when QUIC video is throttled or unreliable.

uninstall.title: Uninstall engine binary?
uninstall.description: This action stops the Traffic Engine (if running) and removes the engine binary. Are you sure you want to proceed? It can be reinstalled at a later time if you change your mind.

onboarding.heading: The bypass engine isn't installed yet
onboarding.body: QManager downloads a small engine binary and verifies it against a pinned checksum before installing. It starts on its own once installed.
onboarding.installing_body: Verifying the download against the release manifest and the pinned checksum. This takes about a minute on a normal connection.
